promise_gap: Ad: 'reduce your electricity bill by more than 90%', 'Subsidy Benefits Available', 'Easy EMI / Loan Options', '25+ Years Performance', 'Govt. Approved Installation', 'Free Site Inspection'.

Six specific claims in one ad. The site backs the segment and the subsidy angle - 'No.1 Solar Company in Telangana', industrial, commercial and residential solar plus solar water heaters - but the ad's destination is an fb.me link, so none of the supporting detail is shown to the person reading the ad, and nothing on this pass verified which of the six the site substantiates.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
